system.name: Charon
system.one_liner: a case study in which the simulator plans a different sequence-parallel configuration per request

content.subject: how zigzag attention splits KV chunks over ranks, and how giving each request its own SP degree shortens the per-rank timelines

panels.label: (a) Zigzag Attention
panels.differs: anatomy of the zigzag split over two ranks

panels.differs: both requests use SP4 zigzag: every rank runs both requests' attention and a second all-gather

values.what: chunk indices, SP degrees (SP4, SP2) and rank assignments

content.key_idea: Choosing the SP degree per request lets short requests use fewer ranks, removing redundant communication and finishing the batch earlier.
content.reading_order: (a) left: chunks and masks per rank; (b) right: top timeline without dynamic SP, bottom per-rank timelines with it, ending at the saved-time arrow.

style.stroke: black ~0.8 pt outlines on bars and cells; dotted outlines for chunks not held locally
style.arrows: black arrows for all-gather; green double arrow for saved time; dashed green vertical finish line
style.font: Aptos, bold for headings and rank labels, regular inside bars

encoding.color_means: hue = request (blue request 1, red request 2); shade = chunk index; green = the gain
encoding.line_style_means: dotted outline = data not resident on this rank; dashed vertical = old finish time
encoding.state_means: w/o vs w/ dynamic SP by which ranks run request-2 operators
encoding.emphasis: saved-time arrow and dashed finish line
reusable_patterns: per-rank operator timelines coloured by request with split fills for shared operators
dashed finish line + labelled double arrow to show saved time
weaknesses: the stacked 'Rank 0~3' label in the top timeline is rotated diagonally

evidence: the simulator-generated dynamic SP plans assign different SP and zigzag configurations to each request within a batch

summary: (a) Zigzag attention: KV chunks 1-4 are all-gathered so that rank 0 computes chunks 1 and 4 and rank 1 chunks 2 and 3 of the causal mask. (b) Per-rank operator timelines for two requests: with SP4 zigzag for both, every rank runs both requests' attention and a second all-gather; with dynamic SP (request 1 SP4, request 2 SP2), ranks 2-3 skip request 2 and the batch finishes earlier, marked by a saved-time arrow.
summary_zh: 案例图：(a) zigzag 注意力怎么把 KV 块分给两个 rank；(b) 每个 rank 的算子时间线，按请求着色（蓝是请求 1、红是请求 2），对比统一 SP4 和按请求选 SP 两种做法，最后用虚线和双箭头标出省下的时间。
